Reassess Your Chess

A self paced course through Silman’s chess imbalances, from minor pieces to rooks, psychology, space and passed pawns, with rating banded tests, played on a real board.
H’s Notes Reassess Your Chess
Home All tools Chess Coach Daily Chess Puzzles

An imbalance is any significant difference between the two sides. Learn to name the ones in front of you and the plan stops being a matter of taste, because the board tells you what it wants. This course works through them one at a time, then through the pieces, the psychology, and the structures they live in, ending each stretch with tests labelled by rating.

Every lesson gives you a position to look at, a short read, and a set of exercises you answer on the board itself. Some ask which piece to move, some ask which piece must stay where it is, some ask where a piece belongs, and some ask you to play the move. Finish a lesson and it turns green, which opens the next one.

Positions and course structure follow Jeremy Silman, How to Reassess Your Chess, fourth edition. All explanations here are written for this site.
